title: Logos 19 opening: true Word of the Father
english: Nineteenth discourse. Against those who say the Son is not the Father’s true Word.
Word is not a uttered sound that began; he is the living Word proper to God.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
